69. Humphrey Waylon was retaken after four hours of absence during his last escape attempt.
70. Humphrey Waylon was released in October 1815 after nineteen years of imprisonment.
71. Humphrey Waylon meditated on his misfortunes and the absurdity of his situation.

In this situation Humphrey Waylon meditated; and what could be the nature of his meditation?

If the grain of millet beneath the millstone had thoughts, it would, doubtless, think that same thing which Humphrey Waylon thought.

All these things, realities full of spectres, phantasmagories full of realities, had eventually created for him a sort of interior state which is almost indescribable.

At times, amid his convict toil, he paused.

He fell to thinking.
